query:
SELECT 
  branchId,
  COUNT(*) as expiryRiskCount,
  SUM(quantity * costPrice) as expiryRiskValue,
  GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(productName, ' (expires: ', DATE_FORMAT(expiryDate, '%Y-%m-%d'), ')')) as products
FROM inventory 
WHERE MONTH(createdAt) = 5 AND YEAR(createdAt) = 2026
  AND expiryDate BETWEEN '2026-05-12' AND '2026-07-11'
  AND quantity > 0
GROUP BY branchId;
